messages:
emily: Heads-up: after last night's VPC egress lockdown + scheduled KMS rotation, multiple GPU warm-pool nodes in prod are failing to finish keystore handshake and time out during node-init. Seen in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Sample error from node logs:
```
2026-04-04T09:22:13Z node-init ERROR keystore decrypt failed: AccessDenied (KMS:Decrypt)
2026-04-04T09:22:14Z warmup WARN join failed: backoff (attempt=4)
```
Not an application crash, joins just stall.

omar: Observed NATGW conntrack saturation in us-west-2, lots of retries to keystore leading to S3 exporter retry storms. Audit invoice risk if retries persist.

ops-bot: ALERT: gpu-warmup-join-fail-rate > 5% over 10m. keystore-decrypt-p95 = 78s.

sanjay: Quick triage: KMS key rotation triggered keystore-proxy restart and a burst of re-auths from ephemeral ENIs. Firewall policy only allowed static privatelink IPs; ephemeral ENIs used by the keystore clients are being blocked. Also an IAM role condition binds to sourceVpcEndpointId, which fails for ENI-originated requests.

lina: Mitigation options ranked: 1) temporary SG egress exception for keystore ENI CIDRs (TTL 45m) limited to port 443 2) add privatelink service name to allowlist (if cloud provider supports) 3) increase NATGW scale & conntrack (expensive) 4) relax IAM condition (requires security review).

emily: I prefer (1)+ short TTL. Keep blast radius minimal. Also reduce auditshipper sampling to 20% to avoid S3 PUT amplification while we fix. Cost tradeoff: extra warm nodes to cover join failures estimated ~ $2.8k/day/region; sampling saves ~ $2.3k/day.

omar: CLI snippet to add SG rule scoped to keystore ENI CIDR (will tag ENIs and limit by tag in infra PR):
```
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0123abcd --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.222.64.0/22 --description "temp allow keystore ENIs"
```
I'll open the PR with revert_on = now + 60m.

sanjay: Also add a pre-rotation canary to the KMS runbook: try `aws kms:Decrypt` from a tagged ENI and verify keystore handshake before rotating keys. That will catch this early.

olps-bot: action: audit-sampler set to 20% (deploy id ds-1145).

ops-bot: task: applied SG egress exception in staging for 15m test window. Warm-pool canaries passed. Applying to prod in 5m.

emily: After prod patch: warm nodes joining again, keystore decrypt p95 ~ 220ms, S3 PUTs from exporter down ~ 80%. Monitoring window open 1h. Please link infra PR and update rotation runbook with the ENI allowlist pre-seed step. Thanks all :thumbsup:
